title: Pehle Jaisi Nahi Rahi Zahra
body:
Baba, Baba
Bin Sahaare Ke Main Uth Nahi Paati Hoon
Jab Se Darwaza Gira
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba, Pehle Jaisi Nahi Rahi Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Pasliyan Dukhti Hain Baithne Uthne Par
Dard Hota Hai Bada
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba, Pehle Jaisi Nahi Rahi Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Se Darbaar Se Lauti Hai Ye Beti Bana
Aa Gayi Baalon Mein Zahra Ke Safedi Baba
Jhuk Gayi Meri Kamar, Ho Gaya Haal Mera
Ek Zaifa Jaisa
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghat Gayi Jism Ki Quwwat Bhi Lahu Behne Se
Saans Ukhadti Hai Zara Der Khade Rehne Se
Ab Namazein Bhi Main Baith Kar Padhti Hoon
Jab Se Pahlu Toota
<<DIVIDER>>
Baithi Hoon To Utha Bhi Nahi Jaata Baba
Apni Gurbat Pe Bohot Aata Hai Mujhko Rona
Jab Uthati Hai Mujhe Meri Beti Zainab
Thaam Kar Haath Mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri Haalat Pe Lahu Aankhon Se Barsaoge
Kya Sitam Mujhpe Hua, Khud Hi Samajh Jaoge
Main Hatati Hoon Rida, Dekh Lo Ek Dafa
Aap Mera Chehra
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekho Kya Zulm Kiya Mujhpe Sitamgaron Ne
Dekho Kitna Mujhe Maara Hai Jafakaron Ne
Kitni Zakhmi Hoon Main, Mera Rukhsara Hai Dekho Kitna Neela
Baba, Pehle Jaisi Nahi Rahi Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Itni Quwwat Se Sitamgar Ne Tamaacha Maara
Baba, Deewar Se Takra Ke Giri Hai Zahra
Aa Gayi Us Din Se Meri Nazron Mein Kami
Dikh Raha Hai Dhundhla
Baba, Pehle Jaisi Nahi Rahi Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Bolti Hoon To Meri Jaan Nikal Jaati Hai
Shiddat-E-Dard Se Aawaaz Badal Jaati Hai
Saans Bhi Dar Dar Ke Fatima Leti Hai, Is Qadar Hai Iza
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae Nadeem, Ahmad-E-Mursal Ki Dulari Dukhtar
Ro Ke Kehti Thi Nabi Paak Ki Pyaari Dukhtar
Dekh Lo Ummat Ne Aapki Beti Ka
Haal Kya Kar Daala
author: Nadeem Sultanpuri
